name: Gyaruko-san
source:
A ghost girl (presumably a high schooler).

A natural at conversation, she has unusually wide circle of ghostly acquaintances.

Unlike Shiori, she doesn't seem too concerned about the past-or passing on.

Instead, she spends her afterlife roaming around town and chatting with fellow ghosts, enjoying her days in carefree leisure.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4141950/Kugayama_Shioris_Death_Diary/]Steam[/url]]
